baseline: Base commit plus pending shared canonical streaming encoder. Both measured variants enable sha2/asm in isolated checkout; the working branch sha2 feature selection is unchanged.
changes: Derive private account-to-root-ID and root-ID-to-manifest indexes from authenticated genesis and the unchanged context ID.
Normalize public root_epoch requests as before, then return a cloned cached ID.
Resolve stored DAG versions first, then borrow cached root manifests; remove root hash recomputation, account scans and per-lookup manifest allocation.
Clone caches with Context; rebuild from authenticated genesis rather than accepting serialized cache data.
workload: 30 fresh 1000-transaction collective fixtures per run; four serial validators; one-unit decrements; test authentication and memory journals; no real signatures/network/fsync.
measurement: Three alternating isolated A/B pairs (A/B, B/A, A/B); no concurrent builds/tests. Timed transaction phases exclude fixture setup, final view and teardown.

validation.no_std: core with no default features passed

review.independent_execution: Both root-cache identity/scope and allocation/rebuild tests passed; comparison JSON inspected.
